entries.quote: You gain resistance equal to 3 + half your level to force and sonic damage.
entries.why: Read innovation-1 (Guns & Gears Remastered, the newest printing — R12) and innovation-5 (2021): neither prints a wearing condition on any INITIAL modification or on Hyper Boosters; the same page writes "While wearing your/the armor" modification by modification, not by tier — on Antimagic Plating, Camouflage Pigmentation, Dense Plating, Layered Mesh, Tensile Absorption, Automated Impediments, Energy Barrier, Multisensory Mask and Physical Protections, and not on Hyper Boosters, a breakthrough (Layered Mesh already carries defensesRequire {armored:true} for exactly that clause). Overdrive's +2 is the separate state variant (whileActive or the cat-…-overdrive mode).

LIT, so this is a visible change for every non-Dryad (and unanswered) Fey Ascension holder. test/lost-condition-blocked-strikes.test.ts.

entries.quote: The damage type and name of the unarmed attack depends on your heritage
entries.why: Each of the ten rows carries whenHeritage on its own heritage (overlay row), tested before the name dedup: a sprite gets exactly its own spark. Not authored, by decision: print's "most sprite heritages not presented in this book also use luminous spark" is hedged ("most"), and the Tian Xia sidebar shows later heritages getting sparks of their own, so a default would hand an unlisted (homebrew) heritage an attack its author may not mean; the player can add one by hand. Still open (display, dark): the row names are Foundry's heritage labels ("LuminousSprite"), not print's attack names (euphoric spark …), because the check matches a Strike counterpart by that name; and the four Tian Xia sparks' damage-type traits are not authored. Dark under the trust gate. test/lost-condition-blocked-strikes.test.ts.

entries.quote: The fly Speed you gain from Fledgling Flight increases to 25 feet.
entries.why: Fledgling Flight (feat-2649) grants its fly Speed only "for this movement", so the standing speeds.fly 25 was a permanent fly Speed (Fully Flighted, feat-2657, is the feat that prints one). Removed; the raise is a mark on Fledgling Flight, RECORD_MARKERS["juvenile-flight"] (Principle C). Dark under the trust gate. test/lost-condition-fixes-modes.test.ts.

entries.quote: You permanently gain the effects of enlarge
entries.why: Agrees with the check lane's entry. Not covered here: enlarge (spell-1514) also prints "The creature is clumsy 1." — a cost no field carries on this record (an under-encoding, not an over-grant).

entries.quote: your maximum Hit Points increase by your level
entries.why: Agrees with the check lane's entry (Foundry's own toggle is the only predicate).

entries.quote: You permanently gain the effects of enlarge
entries.why: strikeDamage appliesTo "all" -> "melee": enlarge (spell-1514) gives "a +2 status bonus to damage rolls on melee Strikes", and Wanderer's Guide encodes MELEE_ATTACK_DAMAGE_BONUS. Gate ON: a longbow's damage is unchanged by the feat (was "plus 2 untyped"), a longsword keeps the +2. The "own toggle" family on the same counterpart is the check lane's print-unconditional entry. Blocked lane (2026-10-17): its type is "status" now, not "untyped" — enlarge prints a STATUS bonus, so a second status bonus to the same Strike takes the higher value instead of adding (the longsword reads "plus 2 status"). test/lost-condition-fixes-eight-legions.test.ts.

entries.quote: You permanently gain the effects of enlarge
entries.why: Foundry's own toggle is the only predicate on this counterpart; print makes it permanent. Agrees with the check lane's entry.

entries.quote: You gain a melee unarmed Strike depending on your heritage, described below.
entries.why: Each row carries whenHeritage on its heritage (born-of-animal claw, -celestial spirit touch, -elements elemental current, -item striking surface, -vegetation root); each of the eight elemental currents also whenHeritageChoice, Born of Elements' own cantrip answer (born-of-elements:cantrip), so the first current no longer wins the name for every element and an unanswered cantrip grants none; the striking surface is two rows on the feat's own damage-type choice instead of an unsubstituted Foundry template as its damage type; names are print's ("Spirit Touch", not "SpiritTouch"). Dark under the trust gate (theirsUnencoded). test/lost-condition-blocked-strikes.test.ts.

entries.quote: Your claws are agile, finesse unarmed attacks that deal 1d6 slashing damage and are in the brawling weapon group.
entries.why: Agrees with the check lane's entry: Foundry's nand predicate only avoids a duplicate with the dragon claws spell for draconic sorcerers; the claws themselves are unconditional.

entries.quote: You gain a climb Speed of 15 feet, but only when climbing ropes and similar objects.
entries.why: Q7 / the 2026-08-22 speed ruling make this a '*', and both carriers already exist — the record's own `situational` star and the mode modes/cat-rope-runner — but both are DARK: Wanderer's Guide encodes `speed` and a prose `note` here, not `conditional`, so the ledger keeps `situational` on this record's OFF list and the mode on lanes.modes, and no approval names them. Removing speeds.climb would leave the player nothing, so it is KEPT and listed. (scripts/conditional-speed-check.mjs's GATE pattern does not match "only when climbing", which is why it never flagged this record.)

entries.quote: You gain a movement speed, unarmed attacks, and potentially other abilities based on your werecreature type.
entries.why: The attacks come WITH the shape. The feat-level grantedStrikes removed; the same attacks ship on the eighteen shape modes modes/were-<type>-animal|hybrid as ModeDef.grantedStrikes (lit: the modes' carrier encodes `conditional`). Gate ON, a werebear: humanoid shape Fist only (was Jaws, Claw, Fist), hybrid/animal Jaws 1d8, Claw 1d6 agile, Fist. Side effect, print-correct: a ratfolk werewolf's own ancestry Jaws (1d4) is back in humanoid shape — the feat's Jaws had claimed the name in build's dedup. Wanderer's Guide gives the attack items outside its ACTIVE_MODES conditional (attacks always) — a contradiction of print already ruled for this record: authorised exception #124 (2026-08-22, "the BOOK wins"), whose record list names werecreature-dedication. Round 3 (import path): a WG import stores those always-on items as build.naturalAttacks ("Werewolf Jaws" d8); with the feat no longer re-stating them they stayed in humanoid shape and doubled in hybrid shape, so buildCharacter now lets a stored attack yield to a shape mode the character's own feat answer unlocks (featGatedModeStrikes in src/rules/build.ts, the same sameNaturalAttack test the feat-level row used). test/lost-condition-fixes-werecreature.test.ts.

entries.quote: You gain thoughtsense as a vague sense that has a range of 30 feet
entries.why: Agrees with the check lane's entry: the vague 30-foot sense is unconditional; the imprecise upgrade "While your Psyche is Unleashed" is the record's whileActive.

entries.quote: the penalties and lost HP from drained both affect you as if the condition values were 1 lower than they actually are
entries.why: The imported maxHpBonus {perLevel:1} paid +level HP to a character who is never drained; removed. The printed reduction belongs in Feat.drainedReduction (the Svetocher shape, conditions.ts), deliberately NOT added: that field is outside the trust gate's strippable universe, so on this record (no Wanderer's Guide row) it would switch on a mechanic the gate keeps off. Dark today. test/lost-condition-fixes-modes.test.ts.
entries.followUp: drainedReduction: 1 once a ruling or approval lights the record (and the enfeebled half has no carrier at all).

entries.quote: A beastkin's hybrid form is their natural shape.
entries.why: The beastkin Change Shape (action-700) prints "most beastkin remain in their hybrid shapes by default. … While in hybrid shape, you gain a jaws unarmed Strike". The default state is the hybrid shape, so the standing Jaws is the default; humanoid shape is the player's deliberate action. Dark under the trust gate.
